name.text: Two transformations with a given result

questiontext.text:
Choose two transformations so that the first followed by the second has the same effect as the [[if test="is(t=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]]. The first transformation must be a [[if test="is(c=\"rot\")"]]rotation[[else]]reflection[[/if]].

First: [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
Second: [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]
[[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
The matrix of the [[if test="is(t=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]] is \({@Tm@}\). For a pair to work, (second) \(\times\) (first) must equal it, and the first must be a [[if test="is(c=\"rot\")"]]rotation[[else]]reflection[[/if]].

One pair that works: the [[if test="is(v1a=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v1a=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]] followed by the [[if test="is(v1b=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v1b=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]], since \({@sm(v1b)@}{@sm(v1a)@} = {@Tm@}\). Another: the [[if test="is(v2a=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v2a=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]] followed by the [[if test="is(v2b=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(v2b=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]].

truefeedback.text: (second) \(\times\) (first) = \({@P2@}{@P1@} = {@Tm@}\). Another pair that works: the [[if test="is(alt1=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(alt1=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]] followed by the [[if test="is(alt2=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(alt2=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]].

Done in the other order these give the [[if test="is(t=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]]. The first transformation's matrix is on the right: check (second) \(\times\) (first) = \({@P2@}{@P1@}\).

Your pair does give the [[if test="is(t=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]], but the first transformation must be a [[if test="is(c=\"rot\")"]]rotation[[else]]reflection[[/if]].

falsefeedback.text: Multiply (second) \(\times\) (first) and compare with the matrix of the [[if test="is(t=\"rx\")"]]reflection in the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ry\")"]]reflection in the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"ryx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"rmyx\")"]]reflection in the line \(y = -x\)[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r90\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) anticlockwise about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r180\")"]]rotation of \(180^\circ\) about O[[/if]][[if test="is(t=\"r270\")"]]rotation of \(90^\circ\) clockwise about O[[/if]], \({@Tm@}\). Your pair gives \({@P2@}{@P1@} = {@P2.P1@}\).
